title: The text recounts the experiences of a man named Hill, who was involved with a far-right group in South Africa during the apartheid era. He witnessed the eviction of colored families and felt deep shame for his role in the events. After returning to England in 1979, he became an infiltrator within the far-right movement, working with journalists to monitor extremist activities. Hill's connections led him to assist in finding safe houses for Italian fascists, but the operation ultimately collapsed due to police actions. Despite facing threats and the consequences of his past, Hill expresses a desire to make amends for his previous racist beliefs and actions, highlighting the personal transformation he underwent after witnessing the impact of racism firsthand.
